messages:
Alex (Finance): Received invoice LC-889 from LumenCore, amount $12,450 split GL 4001 / 4022. PDF attached but NO PO on the PDF — AP flagged and put on hold. Can procurement confirm match or suggest routing?
Marta (Procurement): Got it. Can you drop the PDF here? I’ll check PO registry.
Alex (Finance): https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/LC-889.pdf — thanks.
LumenCore AP: Uploading revised PDF now — vendor rep says PO should be PO-9921 but we may have transposed digits.
Jeff (Ops): FYI we have a blanket PO BLT-432 for LumenCore (covers infra support through 2025). Vendors should reference BLT-432 or BLT-432/CO-7 for extra work.
Marta (Procurement): Searching... I see PO-9920 (closed) and PO-9921 doesn’t exist. BLT-432 is active and includes LumenCore line items. The invoice amount looks like a one-off charge that could be billed against BLT-432 if Ops signs cost allocation.
Jeff (Ops): Confirmed — this looks like an out-of-scope professional services add-on but falls under BLT-432. Sam (previous approver) approved similar last quarter but he left in Jan.
Marta (Procurement): Who can approve now? Need approver to OK charging BLT-432 so AP can match.
Alex (Finance): AP needs either a scanned PO attached to the invoice or an approval note from the cost owner so we can clear the hold.
Nina (Approver): I can approve as acting manager for Sam for this quarter for one-off items. Please add a procurement note and reference BLT-432 in the invoice, then tag me.
Marta (Procurement): Adding procurement confirmation: "BLT-432 covers vendor; charge approved to GL 4001 (70%) / 4022 (30%). Approver: Nina (acting)." Attached procurement memo.
ap_bot: Invoice LC-889 updated in system, procurement note attached, routing to Accounts Payable queue #4521.
LumenCore AP: Uploaded corrected invoice LC-889-v2.pdf with PO reference BLT-432/CO-7 in the header and added vendor remittance note.
Alex (Finance): Received updated PDF with PO reference. Matching OK. Marking invoice as approved for payment and releasing hold. Routing to AP queue for payment on next run. :white_check_mark:
Nina (Approver): Approved for payment. Thanks team.
Jeff (Ops): Thx — can procurement add a short internal note to close the loop for audit (PO reuse justification)?
Marta (Procurement): Will add audit note to the PO. Closing thread.
